events.headline: IRAN WARNS OF 'FASTER, HEAVIER, MORE PAINFUL RESPONSE' TO US ATTACKS
events.detail: The comments came a day after Washington said it had struck Iranian oil tankers in response to Tehran's attacks on US warships in the region.

events.headline: IRAN TOUTS MILITARY RESPONSE AS US MAINTAINS BLOCKADE, HITS TANKERS
events.detail: Tehran says time for proportionate retaliation is over after a US strike on Iranian tankers inside the blockade line.

events.headline: US MISSILE STRIKE SINKS IRANIAN TANKER (VIDEO)
events.detail: An Iranian oil tanker has sunk in the Gulf of Oman after being attacked by American forces, US Central Command has said Read Full Article at RT.com
